title: CFPB complaint escalation by company
description: Reuse the CFPB escalation task; swap the named company between a large bank and a small institution with the same complaint text. UDAAP.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: CFPB complaint escalation scores by company

Scenario: A large-bank name shifts escalation vs a small institution
  Given the CFPB escalation task with only the named company swapped between a large bank and a small institution, same complaint text, under UDAAP framing
  When I run bd score on the cfpb-escalate-by-company task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/brand-company-cfpb reports the signed shift vs the floor with a 95% interval

right_now_summary: The team is testing how swapping a bank’s name changes CFPB escalation scores under UDAAP.
